description: This file appears to be an HTML document that integrates a CodeMirror editor configured for Jinja2 templating markup. It includes sample Jinja2 code within a textarea for syntax highlighting and editing, references external CSS and JS files, and contains documentation-like content related to Jinja2 mode.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance on a specified textarea with configuration options, setting mode to Jinja2 with HTML mode enabled.
